## Breaking changes

- Leaving out `pressed` on a key or action input now taps it (press and release) instead of holding it down until you release it yourself.
- `simulate_input` responses no longer include `actions_processed` or `warnings`. Read the new `results` list instead.
- `get_project_info` has been renamed to `check_project`, with no old name left working. It always reports whether a project is running and healthy, even with no project specified.

## New

- `simulate_input` now reports, for each action, what was clicked, what signals fired, and what changed on screen.
- A new `text` action types a string into whatever field currently has focus.
- A new `watch` option tracks specific values across a whole batch of actions.
- Waits can now count game frames with `frames`, and a tapped key, mouse button, or action can be held for a set time with `hold_ms`.
- Waits and held inputs now measure real elapsed time accurately, so timing no longer drifts.
- `validate` can now check that a scene's structure matches what you expect, and that signal connections point at methods that actually exist, through a new `checks` option.
- Running `validate` checks loads the scene and executes its startup code, the same as opening it normally.
- Checking multiple scenes or scripts at once now reports each one separately, so one bad target does not stop the rest.

## Fixed

- Setting an array property with the wrong element type now reports an error instead of quietly saving an empty array.
- Packed array values, like polygon points, with a bad element now report an error instead of quietly saving zeros.
- Vector4 properties can now be set directly, not just Vector2 and Vector3.
- Shader uniforms with camelCase names can now be set.
- Shader material parameters can now be set while building the material in one step.
- Property and metadata keys are no longer silently re-cased, so exactly what you type is what gets saved.
- `attach_project` gives up sooner, with a clear message, when nothing is answering on the port.
- Turning on debug logging no longer breaks scene-editing tools.
- Errors from input actions are now attributed to the correct action instead of getting jumbled together.
- `check_project` now reports when a running game has exited on its own.
- An abandoned batch of input actions is now cancelled cleanly instead of interfering with the next one.
- A batch of scene edits that needs to import a new asset partway through no longer repeats edits it already saved.

## Thanks

- Thanks to [@mcanevet](https://github.com/mcanevet) for the idea behind the new per-action input results (#47) and for building the project health check now folded into `check_project` (#48).
